mapper.select:
select count(1) from CHB_PRD_ISSUE_SUB issuesub left join chb_prd_baseinfo prdinfo on prdinfo.prod_id = issuesub.prod_id where 1 =1 and prdinfo.status in ('E','M')/*有效状态：有效、修改*/ and nvl(prdinfo.fprod_id,'NULLFP') = 'NULLFP'/*过滤母产品*/
and prdinfo.ISSUING_STATUS = '01'/*发行状态=发行成功*/ and issuesub.SUBMIT_FEEDBACK_STATUS = '03'/*反馈状态=中债通过*/
and to_char(issuesub.PRD_VDATE,'yyyy-MM-dd') <= to_char(#{queryDate,jdbcType=DATE},'yyyy-MM-dd') and not exists( select 1 from chb_prd_end_sub endsub where 1 =1 and issuesub.prod_id = endsub.prod_id
and endsub.SUBMIT_FEEDBACK_STATUS = '03'/*反馈状态=中债通过*/ and to_char(endsub.mdate,'yyyy-MM-dd') <= to_char(#{queryDate,jdbcType=DATE},'yyyy-MM-dd') )
and prdinfo.RAISE_CCY = #{ccy,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
and prdinfo.OPERATE_MODE in ('03','04')
and prdinfo.OPERATE_MODE in ('01','02')
#{prodid,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

select nvl(prddeal.PRDQTY,0) "prdqty", nvl(prdrate.PROD_VALUE,1) "prdvalue", nvl(prdrate.ccy,prddeal.posccy) "raiseccy", prddeal.prod_id "prodid" from ( select sum(prdposition.BALANCE_QTY) PRDQTY,/*取产品头寸的剩余份额，按照同一产品同一币种同一天去汇总*/ prdposition.prod_id prod_id, prdposition.ccy posccy from chb_prd_position prdposition where 1 =1 and to_char(prdposition.CDATE,'yyyy-MM-dd') = to_char(#{queryDate,jdbcType=DATE},'yyyy-MM-dd') group by prdposition.prod_id,prdposition.ccy ) prddeal left join ( select prdrate.prod_id prod_id, prdrate.PROD_VALUE prod_value, prdrate.CCY CCY, rank() over (partition by prdrate.prod_id order by prdrate.CHANGE_DATE desc) ranknum from chb_prd_periodyield prdrate where 1 =1
and prdrate.CHANG_TYPE = '01' /*变动类型=净值变动*/ and to_char(prdrate.CHANGE_DATE,'yyyy-MM-dd') <= to_char(#{queryDate,jdbcType=DATE},'yyyy-MM-dd') )prdrate on prddeal.prod_id = prdrate.prod_id and prdrate.ranknum = 1 left join chb_prd_baseinfo prdinfo on prdinfo.prod_id = prddeal.prod_id left join CHB_PRD_ISSUE_SUB issuesub on prdinfo.prod_id = issuesub.prod_id where 1 =1 and prdinfo.status in ('E','M')/*有效状态：有效、修改*/ and nvl(prdinfo.fprod_id,'NULLFP') = 'NULLFP'/*过滤母产品*/
and issuesub.SUBMIT_FEEDBACK_STATUS = '03'/*反馈状态=中债通过*/
and to_char(issuesub.PRD_VDATE,'yyyy-MM-dd') <= to_char(#{queryDate,jdbcType=DATE},'yyyy-MM-dd') and not exists( select 1 from chb_prd_end_sub endsub where 1 =1 and endsub.SUBMIT_FEEDBACK_STATUS = '03'/*反馈状态=中债通过*/ and issuesub.prod_id = endsub.prod_id
and to_char(endsub.mdate,'yyyy-MM-dd') <= to_char(#{queryDate,jdbcType=DATE},'yyyy-MM-dd') )

select prdinfo.prod_id prd_id, prdinfo.OPERATE_MODE OPERATE_MODE, assetposition.PRD_ASTHOLD_AMT PRD_ASTHOLD_AMT,/*资产持仓*/ assetposition.PRD_BALHOLD_AMT PRD_BALHOLD_AMT,/*负债持仓*/ assetposition.ccy ASSET_HOLD_CCY/*资产负债持仓币种*/ from chb_prd_baseinfo prdinfo left join CHB_PRD_RAISETOT_SUB prdraisesub on prdinfo.prod_id = prdraisesub.prod_id left join CHB_PRD_ISSUE_SUB issuesub on prdinfo.prod_id = issuesub.prod_id left join ( select assetposition.prod_id prod_id, SUM(DECODE(nvl(assetinfosub.asset_type2,'NULLTYPE'),'NULLTYPE',0 ,'REMAININGCASH',0,'1901',assetposition.ACCUAMT,'1902',assetposition.ACCUAMT,'2000',assetposition.ACCUAMT,0)) PRD_BALHOLD_AMT, SUM(DECODE(nvl(assetinfosub.asset_type2,'NULLTYPE'),'NULLTYPE',0 ,'REMAININGCASH',0,'1901',0,'1902',0,'2000',0,assetposition.ACCUAMT)) PRD_ASTHOLD_AMT, assetposition.ccy ccy from chb_asset_position assetposition left join chb_asset_info_sub assetinfosub on assetinfosub.asset_code = assetposition.asset_code and assetinfosub.SUBMIT_FEEDBACK_STATUS = '03'/*反馈状态=中债通过*/
and to_char(assetinfosub.SUBMIT_TIME,'yyyy-MM-dd') <= to_char(#{queryDate,jdbcType=DATE},'yyyy-MM-dd') where 1 =1
and assetposition.CHL_ID = assetposition.ASSET_CODE and assetposition.CHL_ID is not null
and assetposition.CHL_ID != assetposition.ASSET_CODE and assetposition.CHL_ID is not null
and to_char(assetposition.cdate ,'yyyy-MM-dd') = to_char(#{queryDate,jdbcType=DATE},'yyyy-MM-dd') group by assetposition.prod_id,assetposition.CCY/*产品+币种汇总*/ )assetposition on assetposition.prod_id = prdinfo.prod_id where 1 =1 and prdinfo.status in ('E','M')/*有效状态：有效、修改*/ and nvl(prdinfo.fprod_id,'NULLFP') = 'NULLFP'/*过滤母产品*/
and prdinfo.ISSUING_STATUS = '01'/*发行状态=发行成功*/ and issuesub.SUBMIT_FEEDBACK_STATUS = '03'/*反馈状态=中债通过*/
and to_char(issuesub.PRD_VDATE,'yyyy-MM-dd') <= to_char(#{queryDate,jdbcType=DATE},'yyyy-MM-dd') and not exists( select 1 from chb_prd_end_sub endsub where 1 =1 and endsub.SUBMIT_FEEDBACK_STATUS = '03'/*反馈状态=中债通过*/ and issuesub.prod_id = endsub.prod_id
and to_char(endsub.mdate,'yyyy-MM-dd') <= to_char(#{queryDate,jdbcType=DATE},'yyyy-MM-dd') )
and prdinfo.OPERATE_MODE in ('03','04')
and prdinfo.OPERATE_MODE in ('01','02')
#{prodid,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

select prdinfo.prod_id prd_id, prdinfo.OPERATE_MODE OPERATE_MODE, prdraisesub.SUBSCRIBE_CCY_AMT SUBSCRIBE_CCY_AMT/*认购币种及金额*/ from chb_prd_baseinfo prdinfo left join CHB_PRD_RAISETOT_SUB prdraisesub on prdinfo.prod_id = prdraisesub.prod_id left join CHB_PRD_ISSUE_SUB issuesub on prdinfo.prod_id = issuesub.prod_id where 1 =1 and prdinfo.status in ('E','M')/*有效状态：有效、修改*/ and nvl(prdinfo.fprod_id,'NULLFP') = 'NULLFP'/*过滤母产品*/
and prdinfo.ISSUING_STATUS = '01'/*发行状态=发行成功*/ and issuesub.SUBMIT_FEEDBACK_STATUS = '03'/*反馈状态=中债通过*/
and to_char(issuesub.PRD_VDATE,'yyyy-MM-dd') <= to_char(#{queryDate,jdbcType=DATE},'yyyy-MM-dd') and prdraisesub.SUBMIT_FEEDBACK_STATUS = '03'/*反馈状态=中债通过*/
and to_char(prdraisesub.SUBMIT_TIME,'yyyy-MM-dd') <= to_char(#{queryDate,jdbcType=DATE},'yyyy-MM-dd') and not exists( select 1 from chb_prd_end_sub endsub where 1 =1 and endsub.SUBMIT_FEEDBACK_STATUS = '03'/*反馈状态=中债通过*/ and issuesub.prod_id = endsub.prod_id
and to_char(endsub.mdate,'yyyy-MM-dd') <= to_char(#{queryDate,jdbcType=DATE},'yyyy-MM-dd') )
and prdinfo.OPERATE_MODE in ('03','04')
and prdinfo.OPERATE_MODE in ('01','02')
#{prodid,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

select prdinfo.prod_id prd_id, prdinfo.OPERATE_MODE OPERATE_MODE, prddealsub.CCY_PURCHASE CCY_PURCHASE,/*存续期交易币种及申购兑付金额*/ prddealsub.MDATE raiseEnddate from chb_prd_baseinfo prdinfo left join CHB_PRD_ISSUE_SUB issuesub on prdinfo.prod_id = issuesub.prod_id left join ( select prddealsub.prod_id, prddealsub.CCY_PURCHASE CCY_PURCHASE, prddealsub.MDATE MDATE from chb_prd_deal_sub prddealsub where 1 =1
and prddealsub.SUBMIT_FEEDBACK_STATUS = '03'/*反馈状态=中债通过*/ and to_char(prddealsub.SUBMIT_TIME,'yyyy-MM-dd') <= to_char(#{queryDate,jdbcType=DATE},'yyyy-MM-dd') )prddealsub on prddealsub.prod_id = prdinfo.prod_id where 1 =1 and prdinfo.status in ('E','M')/*有效状态：有效、修改*/ and nvl(prdinfo.fprod_id,'NULLFP') = 'NULLFP'/*过滤母产品*/
and prdinfo.ISSUING_STATUS = '01'/*发行状态=发行成功*/ and issuesub.SUBMIT_FEEDBACK_STATUS = '03'/*反馈状态=中债通过*/
and to_char(issuesub.PRD_VDATE,'yyyy-MM-dd') <= to_char(#{queryDate,jdbcType=DATE},'yyyy-MM-dd') and not exists( select 1 from chb_prd_end_sub endsub where 1 =1 and endsub.SUBMIT_FEEDBACK_STATUS = '03'/*反馈状态=中债通过*/ and issuesub.prod_id = endsub.prod_id
and to_char(endsub.mdate,'yyyy-MM-dd') <= to_char(#{queryDate,jdbcType=DATE},'yyyy-MM-dd') )
and prdinfo.OPERATE_MODE in ('03','04')
and prdinfo.OPERATE_MODE in ('01','02')
#{prodid,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

select prdinfo.prod_id prd_id, prdinfo.OPERATE_MODE OPERATE_MODE, nvl(assetdealsub.PRD_ASSET_AMT,0) PRD_ASSET_AMT,/*交易登记金额*/ assetdealsub.ccy PRD_ASSET_CCY/*交易登记币种*/ from chb_prd_baseinfo prdinfo left join CHB_PRD_ISSUE_SUB issuesub on prdinfo.prod_id = issuesub.prod_id left join ( select assetdealsub.prod_id, SUM(assetdealsub.AMT*(decode(assetdealsub.CUR_ASSET_TYPE,'02',1,'04',1,'06',1,'07',1,'09',1,'11',1,-1))) PRD_ASSET_AMT, assetdealsub.CCY CCY from chb_invest_trade_sub assetdealsub where 1 =1
and assetdealsub.SUBMIT_FEEDBACK_STATUS = '03'/*反馈状态=中债通过*/ and assetdealsub.CUR_ASSET_TYPE in ('01','02','03','04','05','06','07','08','09','10','11','12') and to_char(assetdealsub.SUBMIT_TIME,'yyyy-MM-dd') <= to_char(#{queryDate,jdbcType=DATE},'yyyy-MM-dd') group by assetdealsub.prod_id,assetdealsub.CCY/*产品+币种汇总*/ )assetdealsub on assetdealsub.prod_id = prdinfo.prod_id where 1 =1 and prdinfo.status in ('E','M')/*有效状态：有效、修改*/ and nvl(prdinfo.fprod_id,'NULLFP') = 'NULLFP'/*过滤母产品*/
and prdinfo.ISSUING_STATUS = '01'/*发行状态=发行成功*/ and issuesub.SUBMIT_FEEDBACK_STATUS = '03'/*反馈状态=中债通过*/
and to_char(issuesub.PRD_VDATE,'yyyy-MM-dd') <= to_char(#{queryDate,jdbcType=DATE},'yyyy-MM-dd') and not exists( select 1 from chb_prd_end_sub endsub where 1 =1 and endsub.SUBMIT_FEEDBACK_STATUS = '03'/*反馈状态=中债通过*/ and issuesub.prod_id = endsub.prod_id
and to_char(endsub.mdate,'yyyy-MM-dd') <= to_char(#{queryDate,jdbcType=DATE},'yyyy-MM-dd') )
and prdinfo.OPERATE_MODE in ('03','04')
and prdinfo.OPERATE_MODE in ('01','02')
#{prodid,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

select issuesub.prod_id prd_id, prdinfo.PROD_NAME PRD_NAME, issuesub.RAISE_ENDDATE RAISE_ENDDATE, prdraisetotalsub.SUBMIT_TIME RAISE_REGDATE, decode(prdraisetotalsub.SUBMIT_TIME,null,'02','01') IS_REG, case when nvl(prdraisetotalsub.SUBMIT_TIME,#{queryDate,jdbcType=DATE})>prdraisetotalsub.CHB_SUBMIT_DEADLINE then '01' else '02' end RAISE_IS_DELAY from chb_prd_baseinfo prdinfo left join CHB_PRD_ISSUE_SUB issuesub on prdinfo.prod_id = issuesub.prod_id left join chb_prd_raisetot_sub prdraisetotalsub on prdinfo.prod_id = prdraisetotalsub.prod_id and prdraisetotalsub.SUBMIT_FEEDBACK_STATUS = '03'/*反馈状态=中债通过*/ and to_char(prdraisetotalsub.SUBMIT_TIME,'yyyy-MM-dd') <= to_char(#{queryDate,jdbcType=DATE},'yyyy-MM-dd') where 1 =1 and prdinfo.status in ('E','M')/*有效状态：有效、修改*/
and nvl(prdinfo.fprod_id,'NULLFP') = 'NULLFP'/*过滤母产品*/ and prdinfo.ISSUING_STATUS = '01'/*发行状态=发行成功*/ and issuesub.SUBMIT_FEEDBACK_STATUS = '03'/*反馈状态=中债通过*/
and to_char(issuesub.SUBMIT_TIME,'yyyy-MM-dd') <= to_char(#{queryDate,jdbcType=DATE},'yyyy-MM-dd')
#{prodid,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

select asset_code, IS_REG, BOT_ISSUE_NUM, BOT_ISSUE_AMT, BOT_UNINVEST_CASH, sum(nvl(BOT_ASSET_AMT,0)) BOT_ASSET_AMT, sum(nvl(BOT_DEBT_AMT,0)) BOT_DEBT_AMT, CHECK_DATE from( select assetinfosub.asset_code asset_code, decode(bottomassetsub.REGIST_SEQNO,null,'02','01') IS_REG, bottomassetsub.TOTAL_NUM BOT_ISSUE_NUM, bottomassetsub.ISSUE_AMT BOT_ISSUE_AMT, bottomassetsub.UNINVEST_CASH BOT_UNINVEST_CASH, decode(nvl(bottomassetsub.asset_type2 ,'NOASSET'),'1901',bottomassetsub.POS_AMT,'1902',bottomassetsub.POS_AMT,'2000',bottomassetsub.POS_AMT,0) BOT_DEBT_AMT, decode(nvl(bottomassetsub.asset_type2 ,'NOASSET'),'1901',0,'1902',0,'2000',0,'NOASSET',0,bottomassetsub.POS_AMT) BOT_ASSET_AMT, bottomassetsub.POS_DATE CHECK_DATE
from chb_asset_info_sub assetinfosub left join ( select investdealsub.asset_code asset_code,sum(decode(investdealsub.CUR_ASSET_TYPE,'01',1,-1)*investdealsub.num) asset_deal_num from chb_invest_trade_sub investdealsub where 1 = 1 and investdealsub.CUR_ASSET_TYPE in ('01','02')
and investdealsub.SUBMIT_FEEDBACK_STATUS = '03'/*反馈状态=中债通过*/ and to_char(investdealsub.dealdate,'yyyy-MM-dd') <= to_char(#{monthEndDate,jdbcType=DATE},'yyyy-MM-dd') and to_char(investdealsub.SUBMIT_TIME,'yyyy-MM-dd') <= to_char(#{queryDate,jdbcType=DATE},'yyyy-MM-dd') group by investdealsub.asset_code ) assetdeal on assetinfosub.asset_code = assetdeal.asset_code left join ( select bottomassetsub.REGIST_SEQNO REGIST_SEQNO, bottomassetsub.TOTAL_NUM TOTAL_NUM, bottomassetsub.ISSUE_AMT ISSUE_AMT, bottomassetsub.UNINVEST_CASH UNINVEST_CASH, bottomassetsub.POS_AMT POS_AMT, bottomassetsub.plan_asset_id plan_asset_id, subassetinfo.asset_type2 asset_type2, bottomassetsub.POS_DATE from chb_bot_ast_pos_sub bottomassetsub left join chb_asset_info_sub subassetinfo on subassetinfo.asset_code = bottomassetsub.asset_code
and subassetinfo.SUBMIT_FEEDBACK_STATUS = '03'/*反馈状态=中债通过*/ and to_char(subassetinfo.SUBMIT_TIME,'yyyy-MM-dd') <= to_char(#{queryDate,jdbcType=DATE},'yyyy-MM-dd') where 1 =1
and bottomassetsub.SUBMIT_FEEDBACK_STATUS = '03'/*反馈状态=中债通过*/ and to_char(bottomassetsub.pos_date,'yyyy-MM-dd') = to_char(#{monthEndDate,jdbcType=DATE},'yyyy-MM-dd') and to_char(bottomassetsub.SUBMIT_TIME,'yyyy-MM-dd') <= to_char(#{queryDate,jdbcType=DATE},'yyyy-MM-dd') )bottomassetsub on bottomassetsub.plan_asset_id = assetinfosub.asset_code where assetinfosub.asset_type in ('12','16','19')
and assetinfosub.SUBMIT_FEEDBACK_STATUS = '03'/*反馈状态=中债通过*/ and to_char(assetinfosub.SUBMIT_TIME,'yyyy-MM-dd') <= to_char(#{queryDate,jdbcType=DATE},'yyyy-MM-dd') and assetdeal.asset_deal_num > 0 )
group by asset_code, IS_REG, BOT_ISSUE_NUM, BOT_ISSUE_AMT, BOT_UNINVEST_CASH, CHECK_DATE

select prdinfo.prod_id prd_id, prdinfo.PROD_INS_ID PRD_INS_ID, prdinfo.PROD_NAME PRD_NAME, prdinfo.RAISE_VDATE RAISE_STARTDATE, prdinfo.RAISE_ENDDATE RAISE_ENDDATE, prdinfo.VDATE PRD_VDATE, assetdeal.asset_type2 asset_type2, assetdeal.asset_code asset_code, assetdeal.asset_deal_num+initposition.AST_HOLD_NUM AST_HOLD_NUM,/*资产持仓需加上初始持仓*/ decode(nvl(issuesub.REGIST_SEQNO,'NOSEQNO'),'NOSEQNO','02','01') IS_ISSUE_REG from chb_prd_baseinfo prdinfo left join CHB_PRD_ISSUE_SUB issuesub on prdinfo.prod_id = issuesub.prod_id and issuesub.SUBMIT_FEEDBACK_STATUS = '03'/*反馈状态=中债通过*/
and to_char(issuesub.PRD_VDATE,'yyyy-MM-dd') <= to_char(#{queryDate,jdbcType=DATE},'yyyy-MM-dd') and not exists( select 1 from chb_prd_end_sub endsub where 1 =1 and issuesub.prod_id = endsub.prod_id
and endsub.SUBMIT_FEEDBACK_STATUS = '03'/*反馈状态=中债通过*/ and to_char(endsub.mdate,'yyyy-MM-dd') <= to_char(#{queryDate,jdbcType=DATE},'yyyy-MM-dd') ) left join ( select investdealsub.prod_id prod_id, assetinfosub.asset_code asset_code, assetinfosub.asset_type2 asset_type2, sum(decode(investdealsub.CUR_ASSET_TYPE,'01',1,'03',1,'05',1,-1)*nvl(investdealsub.num,0)) asset_deal_num from chb_invest_trade_sub investdealsub left join chb_asset_info_sub assetinfosub on assetinfosub.asset_code = investdealsub.asset_code where 1 = 1 and investdealsub.CUR_ASSET_TYPE in ('01','02','03','04','05','07')
and investdealsub.SUBMIT_FEEDBACK_STATUS = '03'/*反馈状态=中债通过*/ and to_char(investdealsub.dealdate,'yyyy-MM-dd') <= to_char(#{queryDate,jdbcType=DATE},'yyyy-MM-dd') and to_char(investdealsub.submit_time,'yyyy-MM-dd') <= to_char(#{queryDate,jdbcType=DATE},'yyyy-MM-dd')
and assetinfosub.SUBMIT_FEEDBACK_STATUS = '03'/*反馈状态=中债通过*/ and to_char(assetinfosub.submit_time,'yyyy-MM-dd') <= to_char(#{queryDate,jdbcType=DATE},'yyyy-MM-dd') group by investdealsub.prod_id,assetinfosub.asset_code,assetinfosub.asset_type2 ) assetdeal on assetdeal.prod_id = prdinfo.prod_id left join chb_totalcheck_detail initposition on initposition.totalseqno = '111111111111111111111111111111111111'/*初始持仓默认36个1*/ and initposition.prd_id = prdinfo.prod_id and initposition.ASSET_CODE = assetdeal.asset_code where 1 =1 and prdinfo.status in ('E','M')/*有效状态：有效、修改*/ and nvl(prdinfo.fprod_id,'NULLFP') = 'NULLFP'/*过滤母产品*/
and prdinfo.ISSUING_STATUS = '01'/*发行状态=发行成功*/
#{prodid,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

select prdinfo.prod_id prd_id, prdinfo.PROD_INS_ID PRD_INS_ID, prdinfo.PROD_NAME PRD_NAME, prdinfo.RAISE_VDATE RAISE_STARTDATE, prdinfo.RAISE_ENDDATE RAISE_ENDDATE, prdinfo.VDATE PRD_VDATE, nvl(prdraisesub.TOTAL_AMT,0) - nvl(assetdealsub.PRD_ASSET_AMT,0) PRD_CASHHOLD_AMT, decode(nvl(prdissuesub.REGIST_SEQNO,'NOSEQNO'),'NOSEQNO','02','01') IS_ISSUE_REG from chb_prd_baseinfo prdinfo left join CHB_PRD_ISSUE_SUB prdissuesub on prdinfo.prod_id = prdissuesub.prod_id and prdissuesub.SUBMIT_FEEDBACK_STATUS = '03'/*反馈状态=中债通过*/
and to_char(prdissuesub.PRD_VDATE,'yyyy-MM-dd') <= to_char(#{queryDate,jdbcType=DATE},'yyyy-MM-dd') and not exists( select 1 from chb_prd_end_sub prdendsub where 1 =1 and prdinfo.status in ('E','M')/*有效状态：有效、修改*/ and prdendsub.SUBMIT_FEEDBACK_STATUS = '03'/*反馈状态=中债通过*/ and prdissuesub.prod_id = prdendsub.prod_id
and to_char(prdendsub.mdate,'yyyy-MM-dd') <= to_char(#{queryDate,jdbcType=DATE},'yyyy-MM-dd') ) left join CHB_PRD_RAISETOT_SUB prdraisesub on prdinfo.prod_id = prdraisesub.prod_id and prdraisesub.SUBMIT_FEEDBACK_STATUS = '03'/*反馈状态=中债通过*/
and to_char(prdraisesub.submit_time,'yyyy-MM-dd') <= to_char(#{queryDate,jdbcType=DATE},'yyyy-MM-dd') left join ( select assetdealsub.prod_id,sum(decode(assetdealsub.CUR_ASSET_TYPE,'01',1,'03',1,'05',1,'08',1,'10',1,'12',1,-1)*nvl(assetdealsub.CNY_AMT,0)) PRD_ASSET_AMT from chb_invest_trade_sub assetdealsub where 1 =1
and assetdealsub.SUBMIT_FEEDBACK_STATUS = '03'/*反馈状态=中债通过*/ and assetdealsub.CUR_ASSET_TYPE in ('01','02','03','04','05','06','07','08','09','10','11','12') and to_char(assetdealsub.dealdate,'yyyy-MM-dd') <= to_char(#{queryDate,jdbcType=DATE},'yyyy-MM-dd') and to_char(assetdealsub.submit_time,'yyyy-MM-dd') <= to_char(#{queryDate,jdbcType=DATE},'yyyy-MM-dd') group by assetdealsub.prod_id )assetdealsub on assetdealsub.prod_id = prdinfo.prod_id where 1 =1 and prdinfo.status in ('E','M')/*有效状态：有效、修改*/ and nvl(prdinfo.fprod_id,'NULLFP') = 'NULLFP'/*过滤母产品*/
and prdinfo.ISSUING_STATUS = '01'/*发行状态=发行成功*/
#{prodid,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

select prddealsub.prod_id "prodid", CCY_PURCHASE "ccycash" from chb_prd_deal_sub prddealsub where 1 =1
and prddealsub.SUBMIT_FEEDBACK_STATUS = '03'/*反馈状态=中债通过*/ and to_char(prddealsub.MDATE,'yyyy-MM-dd') <= to_char(#{queryDate,jdbcType=DATE},'yyyy-MM-dd') and to_char(prddealsub.submit_time,'yyyy-MM-dd') <= to_char(#{queryDate,jdbcType=DATE},'yyyy-MM-dd')

select prdinfo.prod_id prd_id, assetdeal.asset_code asset_code, sum(decode(assetdeal.rowindexlast,1,assetdeal.unit_price,0)) AST_MAX_UPRICE, sum(decode(assetdeal.rowindexfirst,1,assetdeal.unit_price,0)) AST_MIN_UPRICE, decode(nvl(prdissuesub.REGIST_SEQNO,'NOSEQNO'),'NOSEQNO','02','01') IS_ISSUE_REG from chb_prd_baseinfo prdinfo left join CHB_PRD_ISSUE_SUB prdissuesub on prdinfo.prod_id = prdissuesub.prod_id and prdissuesub.SUBMIT_FEEDBACK_STATUS = '03'/*反馈状态=中债通过*/
and to_char(prdissuesub.PRD_VDATE,'yyyy-MM-dd') <= to_char(#{queryDate,jdbcType=DATE},'yyyy-MM-dd') and not exists( select 1 from chb_prd_end_sub prdendsub where 1 =1 and prdendsub.SUBMIT_FEEDBACK_STATUS = '03'/*反馈状态=中债通过*/ and prdissuesub.prod_id = prdendsub.prod_id
and to_char(prdendsub.mdate,'yyyy-MM-dd') <= to_char(#{queryDate,jdbcType=DATE},'yyyy-MM-dd') ) left join ( select * from( select investdealsub.prod_id prod_id, assetinfosub.asset_code asset_code, decode( investdealsub.num,0,0,investdealsub.CNY_AMT/investdealsub.num) unit_price, rank() over (partition by investdealsub.prod_id,assetinfosub.asset_code order by investdealsub.CNY_AMT/investdealsub.num desc) rowindexlast, rank() over (partition by investdealsub.prod_id,assetinfosub.asset_code order by investdealsub.CNY_AMT/investdealsub.num asc) rowindexfirst from chb_invest_trade_sub investdealsub left join chb_asset_info_sub assetinfosub on assetinfosub.asset_code = investdealsub.asset_code where 1 = 1 and investdealsub.CUR_ASSET_TYPE in ('01','02','03','04','05','06','07','08')
and investdealsub.SUBMIT_FEEDBACK_STATUS = '03'/*反馈状态=中债通过*/ and to_char(investdealsub.dealdate,'yyyy-MM-dd') <= to_char(#{queryDate,jdbcType=DATE},'yyyy-MM-dd') and to_char(investdealsub.submit_time,'yyyy-MM-dd') <= to_char(#{queryDate,jdbcType=DATE},'yyyy-MM-dd') ) where rowindexlast = 1 or rowindexfirst = 1 ) assetdeal on assetdeal.prod_id = prdinfo.prod_id where 1 =1 and prdinfo.status in ('E','M')/*有效状态：有效、修改*/ and nvl(prdinfo.fprod_id,'NULLFP') = 'NULLFP'/*过滤母产品*/
and prdinfo.ISSUING_STATUS = '01'/*发行状态=发行成功*/
#{prodid,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
group by prdinfo.prod_id,assetdeal.asset_code,decode(nvl(prdissuesub.REGIST_SEQNO,'NOSEQNO'),'NOSEQNO','02','01')

select asset_code, IS_REG, BOT_ISSUE_NUM, BOT_ISSUE_AMT, BOT_UNINVEST_CASH, sum(BOT_ASSET_AMT) BOT_ASSET_AMT, sum(BOT_DEBT_AMT) BOT_DEBT_AMT, CHECK_DATE, '01' IS_REG, '01' IS_DEVIATION from( select bottomassetsub.PLAN_ASSET_ID asset_code, decode(bottomassetsub.REGIST_SEQNO,null,'02','01') IS_REG, bottomassetsub.TOTAL_NUM BOT_ISSUE_NUM, bottomassetsub.ISSUE_AMT BOT_ISSUE_AMT, bottomassetsub.UNINVEST_CASH BOT_UNINVEST_CASH, decode(nvl(assetinfosub.asset_type2 ,'NOASSET'),'1901',bottomassetsub.POS_AMT,'1902',bottomassetsub.POS_AMT,'2000',bottomassetsub.POS_AMT,0) BOT_DEBT_AMT, decode(nvl(assetinfosub.asset_type2 ,'NOASSET'),'1901',0,'1902',0,'2000',0,'NOASSET',0,bottomassetsub.POS_AMT) BOT_ASSET_AMT, bottomassetsub.POS_DATE CHECK_DATE
from chb_bot_ast_pos_sub bottomassetsub left join chb_asset_info_sub assetinfosub on bottomassetsub.asset_code = assetinfosub.asset_code
and assetinfosub.SUBMIT_FEEDBACK_STATUS = '03'/*反馈状态=中债通过*/ and to_char(assetinfosub.SUBMIT_TIME,'yyyy-MM-dd') <= to_char(#{queryDate,jdbcType=DATE},'yyyy-MM-dd') where 1 =1
and bottomassetsub.SUBMIT_FEEDBACK_STATUS = '03'/*反馈状态=中债通过*/ and to_char(bottomassetsub.SUBMIT_TIME,'yyyy-MM-dd') <= to_char(#{queryDate,jdbcType=DATE},'yyyy-MM-dd') and to_char(bottomassetsub.pos_date,'yyyy-MM-dd') = to_char(#{monthEndDate,jdbcType=DATE},'yyyy-MM-dd') )
group by asset_code, IS_REG, BOT_ISSUE_NUM, BOT_ISSUE_AMT, BOT_UNINVEST_CASH, CHECK_DATE

select prdinfo.prod_id prd_id, prdinfo.OPERATE_MODE OPERATE_MODE, initposition.PRD_CASHHOLD_AMT PRD_INIT_AMT,/*初始剩余现金*/ initposition.INIT_CCY INIT_CCY /*初始剩余现金币种*/ from chb_prd_baseinfo prdinfo left join chb_totalcheck_detail initposition on initposition.totalseqno = '111111111111111111111111111111111111'/*初始持仓默认36个1*/ and initposition.prd_id = prdinfo.prod_id left join CHB_PRD_ISSUE_SUB issuesub on prdinfo.prod_id = issuesub.prod_id where 1 =1 and prdinfo.status in ('E','M')/*有效状态：有效、修改*/ and nvl(prdinfo.fprod_id,'NULLFP') = 'NULLFP'/*过滤母产品*/
and prdinfo.ISSUING_STATUS = '01'/*发行状态=发行成功*/ and prdinfo.status in ('E','M')/*有效状态：有效、修改*/ and initposition.SEQNO is not null
and issuesub.SUBMIT_FEEDBACK_STATUS = '03'/*反馈状态=中债通过*/
and to_char(issuesub.PRD_VDATE,'yyyy-MM-dd') <= to_char(#{queryDate,jdbcType=DATE},'yyyy-MM-dd') and not exists( select 1 from chb_prd_end_sub endsub where 1 =1 and endsub.SUBMIT_FEEDBACK_STATUS = '03'/*反馈状态=中债通过*/ and issuesub.prod_id = endsub.prod_id
and to_char(endsub.mdate,'yyyy-MM-dd') <= to_char(#{queryDate,jdbcType=DATE},'yyyy-MM-dd') )
and prdinfo.OPERATE_MODE in ('03','04')
and prdinfo.OPERATE_MODE in ('01','02')
#{prodid,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
